company.name: Tremendous
company.shortDescription: Tremendous is the simplest way to send rewards and payouts around the world.
company.description: Tremendous is the simplest way to send rewards and payouts around the world. Over 10,000 teams have used our platform to send more than 10 million payouts globally. We help businesses easily send international payouts to more than 200 countries, and we automate sending by integrating with the tools you already use. We allow businesses to present recipients with 1,000 different redemption options, from Visa and Amazon gift cards to ACH transfers. Plus, we’re free to use. You only spend what you send. We’re a team of 75, fully-remote, highly profitable, and completely self-funded.
